channel.title: The Sun Media Corporation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Sun Media Corporation (thesundaily.my)

item.title: Johor water village fire destroys 30 homes
item.description: A major fire has gutted 30 houses in a Johor water village, destroying most structures and damaging vehicles and boats, with no casualties reported.

item.title: Eva Under Fire confronts demons on new single Murder Scene
item.description: Murder Scene channels pain into power on Eva Under Fire’s return

item.title: Ex-security guard fined RM30,000 for sending obscene texts
item.description: A former security guard was fined RM30,000 by the Sessions Court for sending obscene messages to a woman, with a jail term if he fails to pay.

item.title: USM and Micron launch pioneering semiconductor certification
item.description: USM and Micron launch a first-of-its-kind industry certification to develop skilled talent for Malaysia's growing semiconductor sector.

item.title: Tumbler Ridge mourns victims of rare Canadian school shooting
item.description: A grieving Canadian town held a candlelight vigil for victims of a rare mass shooting, as the community grapples with the tragedy at its local secondary school

item.title: Jakim and MCMC intensify online crackdown on deviant teachings
item.description: Malaysia's Islamic authority boosts digital monitoring with MCMC to swiftly remove online content declared haram, targeting platforms like Facebook and WhatsApp.

item.title: Geneva opera house sells 15,000 stage costumes in grand sale
item.description: Geneva's Grand Theatre sells 15,000 historic stage costumes, from angel wings to a monumental leafy gown, in a rare public sale

item.title: Colombia declares emergency after deadly floods kill 18
item.description: A state of emergency is declared in Colombia as floods kill 18, displace thousands, and destroy over 4,300 homes in the northern cattle belt

item.title: vivo X300 Pro powers CNY film “Unsaid, Still Felt” launch
item.description: vivo Malaysia debuts CNY short film shot on X300 Pro, launches "Let Love Be Spoken" photo contest

item.title: Malaysia’s labour demand hits 9.21 million jobs in Q4 2025
item.description: Malaysia's labour demand grew 1.8% to 9.21 million jobs in Q4 2025, the highest growth since Q1 2024, driven by strong government fiscal support.
